a.name: Letter to Carlisle
a.description: The enquiry written as a ruled letter, Dear Lisa: every blank a labelled field inside the sentence, then the message and a brass send.
a.differs_from: Fields set inline in a ruled letter, not a stacked form; S1 is a plain form under its heading, S2 and S3 sit beside reasons or a heading.

b.name: Litter line-up
b.description: A deep-steel band: the question, a line-up of the six puppies' photos with name and price plates, then a compact three-across form.
b.differs_from: A photo line-up of all six puppies over the form on a deep band; the built rows have no photo and sit plain or in a card.

c.name: Doorstep tray
c.description: A sunk steel-100 tray: a London puppy-and-family photo with the ways to reach us on the left, the question and a two-up form right.
c.differs_from: A section photo beside the form inside a sunk tray (no shadow); S3 is a raised card with no photo, S1 and S2 plain with none.
